mia: heads up — eval-bot posted overnight run for rwd-v2-int4. sparkline shows a sharp drop on a small prompt cohort. seems concentrated in coherence-suite and fewshot-math. tagging owners for an initial pass.

eval-bot: [AUTOMATED] 3581233240 run complete. failures: coherence-suite (Δ -11.8%), fewshot-math (Δ -17.9%). baseline: rwd-v2-fp16. variant: rwd-v2-int4. affected cohort: 612 prompts (tail). full CSV: https://s3.redwood/evals/3581233240.csv

jordan: copying in @sam and @rachel. looks like quantized-int4 regression rather than prompt drift from cursory glance. can someone grab a reproducible sample?

sam: i'll take infra/system checks — kv-cache, batching params, serving kernel. will validate that int4 artifact isn't from recent runtime change.

rachel: i'll run a quick local eval on the failing cohort. command i use:

```bash
python -m rwd_eval.run --model rwd-v2-int4 --suite coherence-suite --cohort path/to/cohort.csv --limit 200
```

rachel: also saving 5 representative prompts + model outputs here for eyeballing: https://s3.redwood/snapshots/358123_snap.txt

jordan: if this is quantization-caused we'll likely see shorter/hallucinated continuations or tokenization differences. rachel — can you paste 2 examples that demonstrate the failure pattern?

rachel: example 1: prompt id 99872 — expected: consistent step-by-step reasoning; int4 produced: single-sentence contradictory claim.

rachel: example 2: prompt id 100001 — math fewshot: expected numeric derivation, int4 output truncated to "I don't know" style response.

eval-bot: EXTRA METRICS: mean token length (fp16)=48.3 vs (int4)=39.6 on failing cohort; perplexity delta +22%.

sam: infra checks — no recent rollout to serving kernels in the window, but autoscaler bump occurred 02:12 UTC which changed batching shape. investigating if batching/kvcache interplay changed token-streaming behavior.

jordan: assigning ownership: model/eval owner = jordan, infra owner = sam. severity = P2 (service degraded for specific cohort, not global). fallback plan: route traffic for 'customer-synthetic' cohort to fp16 until root cause found. @eng-platform FYI.

mia: noted. please add a short summary in the ticket and include repro steps + 5 failing examples. if delayed >2h escalate to oncall. :alarm_clock:

sam: created INF-1287 and attached logs + p95 latency delta. ticket link: https://jira.redwood/INF-1287. added owners and first-pass hypothesis (quantization-batching interplay).

jordan: i'll run a controlled A/B with fp16 vs int4 for the failing prompts and post diffs by EOD.

mia: thanks — moving this to handoff board. ping here when you have repros or if the pattern widens.

sam: quick note: if anyone needs a temp workaround, re-route the failing route to rwd-v2-fp16 via routing policy: `route: cohort -> fp16` until cleared.

rachel: joining jordan for the repro now, will paste concrete outputs in the ticket.

mia: appreciated, pls mark ticket with "cohort-size: small-tail" and "impact: model-quality".

jordan: will do.
